string.name: home_where_body
string.value:
Bring up the keyboard and open "Settings" at the right of the candidate bar.

- Add and remove user dictionary entries
- Review and restore deleted candidates
- Keyboard layout and conversion engine
- Reset learning

All of these live in the keyboard's settings screen.

string.name: home_enable_body
string.value: Enable shunti Japanese IME in System Settings > General > Keyboard & input method, then switch to it with the globe icon in a text field.

Please read the privacy policy before using shunti Japanese IME.

- All input and conversion history is processed only on this device
- Nothing is ever sent to an external server
- No analytics or advertising SDKs are used
